caption:
Meet SehatFlow, a pharmacy management platform we designed and built in-house. 💊

Pharmacies juggle sales, stock, suppliers and reports, often across several tools and a lot of manual typing. SehatFlow brings it into one fast workspace:

▸ Sales, inventory, purchasing & reporting in one place
▸ AI-assisted invoice import, so less manual data entry
▸ A built-in drug interaction checker

Building our own products keeps us sharp. We know what it takes to go from idea to a real SaaS platform that real businesses rely on.
